---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |>
  mutate(hit_number_one = min(rank) == 1, .by = track) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track, color = hit_number_one)) +
  geom_line(aes(alpha = hit_number_one), linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = c(1, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#7b2cbf", `FALSE` = "gray70"),
    labels = c(`TRUE` = "Reached #1", `FALSE` = "Never reached #1")
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.25), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "The Life of a Hit Song, 2000",
    subtitle = "Each line is one song's rank on the Billboard Hot 100, week by week",
    x = "Weeks on the chart",
    y = "Chart rank",
    color = NULL,
    caption = "Source: billboard data from the tidyr package"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```
